_comment: Smoke test run configuration. Use this for quick sanity checks after every deployment.
_run_name_comment: Human-readable name for this run. Replace {{DATE}} with today's date.
_test_type_filter_comment: Only generate/push test cases of this type. Options: smoke | regression | functional | security | performance | negative
_target_modules_comment: Which EXAMPLE modules to target. Remove any modules you don't want to test in this run.

source_files._comment: Silent failure risk — must check the success flag in response body
Core workflow controller — check response body for success flag
Known bug EXAMPLE-101 — 404 instead of 302 for unauthenticated requests
Known bug EXAMPLE-102 — 500 on missing session cookie

_source_files_comment: List of files to analyze. Each entry needs 'file' (relative path from repo root) and 'module' (EXAMPLE module name).
_priority_filter_comment: Only include test cases of these priorities. Smoke = critical + high only.
_dry_run_comment: Set to false when ready to push to Jira/Xray. Keep true for local preview.
_output_file_comment: Where to save the generated test cases JSON. Replace {{DATE}} with today's date.
_chunk_size_comment: Max lines per chunk when splitting large files. 200 is safe for most controllers.
_push_to_xray_comment: Set to true to automatically push valid test cases to Xray after generation.
_jira_labels_comment: Labels to apply to every Jira issue created in this run.
